items.en: In your opinion, is truth absolute or relative?

items.uz: Menimcha, bu savolga bir xil javob yo'q.
items.en: In my opinion, there's no single answer to this question.

items.uz: Har bir davr o'z haqiqatini yaratadimi, deb o'ylaysizmi?
items.en: Do you think every era creates its own truth?

items.uz: Qisman, ammo ba'zi haqiqatlar o'zgarmas bo'lib qoladi.
items.en: Partially, but some truths remain unchanging.

items.uz: Hatto eng qat'iy fikr ham vaqt o'tishi bilan o'zgarishi mumkin.
items.en: Even the most firm opinion can change over time.

items.uz: Faqat ochiq muhokama orqali haqiqatga yaqinlashamiz.
items.en: Only through open discussion do we get closer to the truth.

items.uz: Bu fikringizga qo'shilaman, garchi to'liq rozi bo'lmasam ham.
items.en: I agree with this opinion of yours, although I don't fully agree.
Reaching absolute agreement in philosophy is difficult.

items.uz: Ana shu murakkablik falsafani qiziqarli qiladi.
items.en: It is precisely this complexity that makes philosophy interesting.

items.uz: Bu suhbat uchun tashakkur, ko'p narsani o'yladim.
items.en: Thank you for this conversation, I thought about many things.
